newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN PARTIES AGREE ON NATO REFERENDUM BY NOV.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN PARTIES AGREE ON NATO REFERENDUM BY NOV.

text.p: Hungary's seven parliamentary parties agreed on Thursday that a referendum about the country's NATO membership should be called by the end of November, the Hungarian news agency MTI said.
The parties also agreed that the parliament will approve on 15 July a statement in appreciation of the Tuesday decision of the Madrid NATO summit to invite three countries for membership talks.

On Wednesday all the parliamentary parties welcomed the invitation of the Czech Republic, Poland and Hungary into NATO, and said the Madrid decision was a recognition of efforts by the three Central European states to integrate into the West.
